utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the twentieth. Have we got everyone on? Reidy, your picture's frozen, but that's fairly normal.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I'm here. That's just my enthusiastic face.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Morning. The heating in the portakabin is actually working for once. I'm sat here in a coat, absolutely roasting. Not a maintenance request, before anyone says it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Luxury. Usually warmer stood outside it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, well, apparently we've gone straight from refrigeration to kiln.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're on important matters, the charity bake sale on Friday. Saw the poster coming in. Reckon there'll be anything left by our break?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not if you get there first, Marc.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, cake forecast noted. Actual plant stuff. I already swapped the filter on the big board yesterday, so that's finished, not another job.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, the filter change is closed. Separate from the purchasing bit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. And I signed off the inspection on the big board on Tuesday — earlier this morning, I mean. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, I finished the repair on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot last night. That's complete.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, Mide, you clipped out. Finished, you said?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Finished, yeah. Not carrying that repair forward.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: saw the pressure on the power pack on one dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Nothing further to add to that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation only. We're not turning that into an action on this call.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Similar thing, different kit — saw the pressure on the heater box on one dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Just mentioning what I saw.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right, two separate observations, then. Not one fault with two names.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Blocked items: the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the tower. That remains blocked; no new action against it here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the GT1 compressor. Same situation, still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Also, the shutdown on the stacker is cancelled now, production need it running. Take that out of the picture.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, cancelled. We're not treating that as shutdown work still waiting to happen.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Reidy, can you inspect the GT2 water valve for leaks?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll inspect the GT2 water valve for leaks. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: The valve itself, yeah? Not getting muddled with the compressor item we've just mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, separate thing entirely. Inspection for leaks, as asked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Reidy, can you also do a site visit at the water works with the contractor at half two? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't take that one, sorry. Can't get off the floor for that slot. The valve's fine, but not the visit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Ash, can you take the site visit at the water works with the contractor instead? Still at half two; it matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the site visit at the water works with the contractor at half two. That works for me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, Ash. Sorry, should've said before you got all the way through it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No bother. I'll run a function test on the line 2 guard tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Saz, is that a drop-everything one, or a whenever you get a chance sort of thing?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Whenever you get a chance is the priority on that one, yeah. I'll fit the function test on the line 2 guard into tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Right, tomorrow morning, but not top of the queue. Got you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ash, could you chase the purchase order for the big board after lunch? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, can I pass on that? With the visit in the afternoon, I don't want to say yes and then leave it hanging.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Marc, can you take that instead — chase the purchase order for the big board after lunch? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the big board after lunch. No rush, understood.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And that's the purchase order, not reordering the filter that's already been changed. Just keeping those separate in my head.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. Jamie, can you order spare parts for the HRSG tomorrow? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll order spare parts for the HRSG tomorrow, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over the end there. Heard you now.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No worries. Teams does that little pause and then gives you everyone at once, doesn't it?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: While we're on the plant, I'll grease and check the bearings on the Gas Turbine 1 by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Ash. For that one, not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, by Thursday. I'll keep that date; I'm not treating it as an emergency.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right. Different status to the blocked delivery, then. Easy to mash those together when you're half listening.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Mide, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team. Normal priority, got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You always sound delighted when we say toolbox talk.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: This is my delighted voice. Same model as your enthusiastic face.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances on Friday. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Boss, just so I've heard that properly — urgent, but the checks are on Friday?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, on Friday, before use. I'll do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances myself. It's urgent, not one to squeeze out.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: So cake doesn't outrank it. Glad we've established the hierarchy.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cake has never outranked it, despite your best efforts.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And just to keep my bit tidy, that pressure dip I mentioned was an observation, not me asking for another job to go on the list.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same for mine. It recovered on its own; I wasn't volunteering anybody for anything.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Supplier delivery still in the blocked column as well. Nothing's changed during the call, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Those stay blocked, the stacker shutdown stays cancelled, and the finished repairs stay finished.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Lovely. A closed job actually staying closed. Rare treat.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Did we lose the last bit, or has everyone gone quiet?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just quiet. Enjoy it while it lasts.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
